From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>

Subject: Draft MAP toolkit + eval timeline for ClearTech pilot

Anna — attaching our first-pass Mutual Action Plan and a kickoff slide deck for the pilot. This is the MAP toolkit I mentioned on last week's call: a two-tab gdoc (milestones + owner matrix) and a short slide deck with the proposed 6-week evaluation cadence.

Quick notes:
- Primary ask: please review the milestones and owners (Sheet: "Core milestones") and confirm any additional stakeholders we should loop in.
- Security checkpoint: we put a placeholder for your SOC 2 checklist at week 2 — if you have a recommended owner we can slot them in.
- Proposed kickoff workshop: Tue Nov 17 11:00–11:45 PT (30–45m) — quick tech + stakeholders.

Links & attachments:
- GDoc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/clearchtech-map-v1 (ClearTech_MAP_v1.gdoc)
- Slides: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/clearchtech-map-deck-v1 (ClearTech_MAP_kickoff_deck_v1.gslides)

Attachments: [Attachment: ClearTech_MAP_v1.gdoc (Google Doc)], [Attachment: ClearTech_MAP_kickoff_deck_v1.gslides (Google Slides)]

Can you take a look by EOD Friday so we can lock owners and send invites? I asked Marissa to add the initial success metrics and Ben to add run-rate estimates for the Dedicated pilot.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0183

Thanks Mina — this looks like a great starting point. A few quick requests from our side:

1) Can you surface the security checkpoint deliverables explicitly (e.g., SOC 2 evidence, network diagram, data retention document)? We need to present those to our compliance lead.
2) KPI suggestions: can you add two measurable success metrics for each milestone (latency SLA, throughput targets, sample eval queries passed)?
3) Please include Sam (cc'd) as our technical lead on the MAP — he'll own the integration testing.

We can do Tue Nov 17 for a kickoff — 11:00 PT works for us, please send calendar invite and dial-in. We'll review the doc internally and come back with inline comments by Thursday.

Best,
Anna Lopez
Head of Product Operations | ClearTech
anna@cleartech.io | +1 (206) 555-0124
